text:
Maya Chen: Quick sync — final SEO checklist for the webinar + launch posts. Need: KW mapping, JSON-LD schema snippets for speaker pages, internal link placements across the blog hub, a lightweight redirect plan for legacy landing pages, and inbound lead-routing handoff into Marketo. Can owners chime in?
Ryan Patel: I can take keyword mapping for the webinar landing + 2 blog posts. I'll prioritize longtails around 'low latency LLM inference' and 'inference cost optimization'.
Tess Nguyen: I'll own JSON-LD speaker & event schema. Planning to add breadcrumbs and eventAction data. Will drop snippets by EOD.
Samir Ali: Redirect plan — I scanned old campaign URLs. Shortlist looks like: `/webinar-old-signup`, `/launch-alpha` -> these should 301 to new landing. Putting a draft redirect table in the doc.
Olivia Park: I'll coordinate internal linking: hero blog -> webinar landing -> product docs. Also want a CTA flow for the post-webinar benchmark narrative so leads land on the right route.
Maya Chen: @Ryan please add 10 target phrases and map them to the three assets (landing, blog1, blog2). Use the benchmark copy: 'up to 40% cost savings in production' as a headline variant, but mark as claim-verified only after analytics signoff.
Ryan Patel: Added list in the doc. For meta titles I suggested A/B variants: `Redwood Inference — Low-Latency LLM Serving` and `Reduce LLM Inference Cost by 40%`.
Tess Nguyen: JSON-LD snippet (speaker + event) I'm dropping here for review:```json
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "Event",
  "name": "Redwood Inference Webinar: Serving LLMs in Production",
  "startDate": "2026-04-07T10:00:00Z",
  "organizer": { "@type": "Organization", "name": "Redwood Inference" }
}
```
Samir Ali: Redirect rules I'll propose to infra:```text
301 /webinar-old-signup https://redwood.com/webinar-2026
301 /launch-alpha https://redwood.com/launch
```
Olivia Park: For internal linking, here's the quick plan: - Update hero blog with 2 contextual anchors to the webinar page (anchor text: "live benchmark" and "register for webinar") - Add a canonicalized hub page that aggregates webinar assets and benchmark graph - On post-launch post, include in-body CTA to the demo request form (route: `/contact/demo?src=webinar`).
Maya Chen: seo-bot ran the schema lint — result: speaker schema missing `sameAs` social links for two speakers. @Tess can you add? :robot_face:
seo-bot: Schema lint: 2 warnings, 0 errors. Suggested fix: add `sameAs` for speaker profiles and ensure `startDate` is ISO-8601.
Tess Nguyen: Will add sameAs links and re-run lint. Also flagging that event `startDate` timezone needs to be UTC in the live page.
Ryan Patel: On messaging iteration — for the benchmark narrative, propose three headline tiers: 1) technical (latency+cost), 2) business (TCO reduction), 3) customer (time-to-market). We should test headlines in email + hero.
Olivia Park: I'll set up a simple A/B test in the email send and the hero CTA copy. Tracking param: `?utm_source=webinar&utm_variant=X`.
Samir Ali: For inbound routing: Marketo form should add hidden field `lead_source=webinar-2026` and a `landing_page` value for routing. Also request to ops: create a Zap from Marketo -> SFDC queue for webinar-qualified leads.
Maya Chen: Action list recap: - Ryan: KW map + meta title variants (due: tomorrow) - Tess: JSON-LD speaker/event + sameAs fixes (due: EOD) - Samir: 301 redirect table + infra ticket (due: today) - Olivia: internal linking plan + CTA A/B (due: next week) - Ops: Marketo fields + routing (owner: Samir to coordinate)
Tess Nguyen: Thumbs up. I'll ping when snippets are in the doc. :thumbsup:
Ryan Patel: Noted — I'll also add the benchmark copy caveat for legal review.
Maya Chen: Thanks team — please update the doc with PR links. If anyone hits blockers with infra or Marketo, drop here and I'll escalate. :sparkles:
